pricing.rule: Each delivered call bills price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005. A pending/async ack or an unverifiable charged call (delivered:false, refundable:false) bills price_usd × 1.15 with no per-call fee; refunded calls, in-batch duplicates and failed runs bill $0. A call runs only when its full delivered amount fits the batch's remaining max_usd, so max_usd must be at least Σ(price_usd × 1.15 + $0.005).

Most people look at a chart and ask: How much can I make today?

I’d rather ask a different question:

What could $PQC.market become if the right people discover it, believe in the idea and stick around to help it grow?

At $24K market cap, it’s still a very early-stage project. That also means the risks are real, and there’s a lot left to prove.

Don’t buy just because someone tells you to. Do your own research, understand what you’re holding, and make your own decision.

I’m interested in seeing what this project can build over time.
